question: Why did the error rate go up on 26 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of search v2.20 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: The deployment of search v2.20 introduced a new version of the service.
This new version was deployed 4 minutes before the error rate spike.
The error rate increased significantly after the deployment, indicating the deployment was the cause.

contributing_factors.description: NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize caused the error.
why_chain: The deployment of search v2.20 introduced a new version of the service.
This new version caused a NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize.
This NullPointerException led to the error rate spike.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate spike.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in p95 latency caused the error rate spike.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of catalog v6.12 caused the error rate spike.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment of catalog v6.12 happened 4 minutes before the change, not 4 minutes after.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service search in region ap-south rose from 0.34% to 2.99% (+791%), with a change point at 2026-03-26T06:20:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.17).
At the same time, request volume for service search in region ap-south stayed about the same (506 per 5 min before, 603 per 5 min after, +19%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service search in region ap-south stayed about the same (141 ms before, 140 ms after, -1%).
Deployed search v2.20 to ap-south (search, ap-south; 4 min before the change; record R011)
High error rate on search in ap-south (search, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R014)
search: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.20) (search, ap-south; 2 min after the change; record R013)
search: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.20) (search, ap-south; 22 min after the change; record R015)
Deployed catalog v6.12 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 4 min before the change; record R012)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (4 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Fix the NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize in the new search v2.20 version.
Monitor the error rate and request volume closely after any deployment to ap-south.
Review and test the new search v2.20 version in a staging environment before deploying to production.
